missing_history.headline: Attach a root source or attest the gap

stale_structural_lineage.headline: Re-run assembly against the current chain evidence

stale_custody_component_lineage.headline: Re-review this link against the current custody projection

unknown_origin.headline: Record where these funds came from

missing_pricing.headline: Add a fiat price for this transaction

asset_mismatch.headline: Re-review the link with matching assets

source_asset_mismatch.headline: Pick a source whose asset matches the link

transaction_overallocation.headline: Reduce the link allocation to the parent transaction amount

source_overallocation.headline: Reduce link allocations or split across multiple sources

source_amount_missing.headline: Set the source's amount before exporting

path_truncated.headline: Resolve the upstream path or attest a missing-history stop

path_cycle.headline: Break the cycle by removing one of the reviewed links

unreviewed_link.headline: Review the suggested link or reject it

ambiguous_allocation.headline: Set an explicit allocation amount and policy on the link

unconfirmed_chain_data.headline: Confirm or remove the chain observation backing this link

chain_observation_privacy.headline: Chain-only evidence is context, not proof: add primary evidence

privacy_hop_unresolved.headline: Attach explicit evidence covering the privacy hop

chronology_violation.headline: Pick a parent dated on or before the child transaction

opening_balance_attestation.headline: Opening-balance attestations are weaker than primary evidence
